headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 3, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a 4-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Max Meyer earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 1 earned run. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other action, the Detroit Tigers took down the Tampa Bay Rays 7-2, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense and Troy Melton dominating on the mound. The Chicago White Sox shut out the Minnesota Twins 8-0, with Andrew Benintendi leading the offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The New York Mets secured a 7-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Freddy Peralta earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Trevor Story has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a sports hernia. Sean Murphy has also been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a fractured left middle finger. Joe Mantiply has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with left knee inflammation. Travis d'Arnaud has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right foot plantar fasciitis. Matt Gage has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right knee inflammation. Rob Zastryzny has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a left trapezius strain. Nick Sogard has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right oblique strain. Jonathan Heasley has been placed on the 15-day injured list.

The Atlanta Braves have acquired catcher Austin Wynns in a trade with the Los Angeles Angels, who received cash in return. The Toronto Blue Jays have acquired right-hander Simeon Woods Richardson in a trade with the Minnesota Twins, who received cash in return. The Minnesota Twins have also acquired right-hander Justin Lawrence in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates, who received cash in return. The Detroit Tigers have traded right-hander Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for left-hander Juanmi Vasquez.
